_levels: Files are pre-levelled: music and stings -16 LUFS (true peak <= -1 dBFS), ambiance -20 LUFS, sfx loudest 400 ms at -16 dBFS RMS with peaks <= -1 dBFS. volume_db is the suggested mix offset on top, so the mix lives here, not in the files.
_loops: Loops have loop=true in their .import (Godot AudioStreamMP3). Music loops are Ludo's loop-adjusted tracks played end to end; ambiance loops are equal-power circular crossfades of 2 takes (17.0 s).
_fields: file (relative to base), bus, volume_db, when (the game event that plays it), loop, fade_in_s/fade_out_s (suggested), max_polyphony (voices of this event at once), cooldown_ms (minimum gap between plays), pitch_jitter (+/- fraction for pitch_scale; take the offset from the event index, e.g. a hash of it, never from an RNG: M3's battle screen bans random calls in ui/battle_*.gd).

music_title.when: title screen and new-game setup; loops

music_map.when: the map while players plan their orders; loops

music_battle.when: while a battle plays back; loops; duck music_map under it

sting_victory.when: a won battle's result card, and the game-won screen

sting_defeat.when: a lost battle's result card, and the game-lost screen

amb_map.when: under the map at all times (wind, leaves, birdsong); loops

amb_battle.when: under a battle playback (wind, banners, distant armies); loops (file sits at -22.7 LUFS, 2.7 dB under the other bed: its transients hit the peak ceiling)

ui_hover.when: pointer enters a button or a hoverable row

order_queued.when: an order is added (move, recruit, research)

order_cancelled.when: an order is removed or undone

end_turn.when: the player commits their orders (End turn)

turn_start.when: a new turn starts, and the hotseat handoff screen

recruit.when: a unit or commander is recruited (on queue, or when it appears in the turn report)

march.when: an army is given a move order, or starts to move in the turn report

battle_clash.when: a melee attack is blocked or both fronts collide; alternate with battle_hit

ruler_death.when: a ruler dies (battle or turn report)

succession_crown.when: an heir is crowned or a ruler returns (succession)

sacrifice.when: the ruler sacrifices power for a new mandate
